Many.describes: a collection of values in one reading; zero values is an explicit empty collection, not a hole

Maybe.describes: deliberate optionality: one value, or a deliberate absence that d1 answered

Later.describes: a value that depends on work not yet done: an unavailable dependency, not a scheduled computation

explain.asks: explain or answer something: say why, how or what, or confirm or deny it

research.asks: look something up, or find inspiration or sources

redesign.asks: change how the page or the interface looks, or how its information is ordered

release.asks: release, deploy, push, tag, or change a version number

delegate.asks: have another agent, a sub agent or a new session do part of the work

show.asks: show or open something so that the user can see it

test.asks: test or verify that something works

follow.asks: follow a rule about how to work or what to avoid, from now on

save.asks: save or store data so that it can be found later

propose.asks: propose an idea and wait for the user's yes or no
